transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I came in because I keep getting these nagging thoughts. I'm a designer, and I just keep worrying that I've missed some tiny mistake in a layout, or maybe that I sent the wrong version of a file to a client. And even when I can see that it's probably fine, my mind just... keeps circling back to it. It's been pretty frustrating to deal with.
When these thoughts come back, do you feel driven to repeatedly check or mentally review your work to relieve the anxiety?

Yeah, I do. Um, before I submit any work now, I'll usually re-open the file just to be sure. I go in and compare the layers, re-save it, and... sometimes I just mentally walk through every single design choice one more time in my head. 

It's not like it takes over my whole day or anything, but it definitely makes me slower. It just makes me feel a lot less free creatively when I'm constantly doing that.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about many different areas of your life, or is it mainly focused on possible mistakes in your design work?

Um, it's really mainly focused on my work. I don't think I worry excessively about other areas of my life. Like, my personal life or my health or finances... I feel pretty normal about all that. It just really zeroes in on the design files and whether I messed something up there.
